explicit_required_attachments.description: If policy=explicit, list attachment rels required (e.g., transparency_receipt, gossip_summary).

required_attachments_policy.description: Whether required attachments are taken from the attachment-requirements registry or enumerated in this rule.

trigger.description: Deadline trigger identifier. SHOULD be in artifacts/registries/publication-triggers.csv; experimental triggers may be namespaced as x-<org>.<trigger>.

signature_placeholder.description: Placeholder for signing policy; real deployments should sign the envelope, not this payload.
